## Description of PR


## PR Naming Conventions (Conventional Commits)

- fix: patching unintended behaviour in the codebase (increments SemVer Patch)
- feat: Creation of a new feature (increments SemVer Minor)
- feat!/fix!: Represents a breaking change (increments SemVer major)
- build: changes to build system, dependencies, or tooling.
- chore: routine tasks that don’t affect app logic or behavior.
- ci: updates to continuous integration pipelines or automation.
- docs: documentation-only changes.
- style: formatting changes with no code logic impact.
- refactor: code restructuring without changing behavior.
- perf: performance improvements.
- test: adding or updating tests.
